## Summary
Idris Olubisi is a Senior Developer Relations Engineer with 5+ years building thriving developer communities across Web2 and Web3. He builds for the agent era — where developers and AI agents discover and adopt infrastructure — having shipped an MCP server serving 11,900+ AI-agent tool calls and re-architected documentation for LLM and agent retrieval. He founded Web3 Afrika (15,000+ builders across Africa), writes for 200,000+ developers a year, and is widely regarded as one of the most active developer relations engineers in Africa's technology ecosystem.

## Selected Projects

**SwoopAgent** - Self-hosted, multi-tenant autonomous AI-agent platform on Base
Full-stack TypeScript (Next.js App Router, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, Redis) with Privy embedded wallets, 0x onchain swaps, and Stripe billing. Engineered for money-movement correctness: atomic execution, Redis idempotency keys, rate limiting, and an independent stop-loss / circuit-breaker safety net. Running live with real users.

Full-stack Next.js product with Stripe payments, AI features, real-time multiplayer (live quiz, leaderboards), PWA, and push notifications. Shipped and maintained solo.
